title: feat: allow agent composition
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Allows `ag_` run tokens to call managed and endpoint agents while preserving inherited model permissions and parent-key billing.
- Adds `agent: true|false` filtering to MCP `listModels` and keeps the returned agent marker visible.
- Updates MCP instructions and `generateText` guidance so agents can discover and delegate to other agents.

gist.headline: Agents found the hive mind
gist.blurb: Agents can now hand work to other agents without dropping their inherited permissions or losing track of the pollen tab. The tiny delegation tree has become an actual forest.
gist.summary: Agent run tokens prefixed with ag_ can now call managed and endpoint agents with inherited model permissions and parent-key billing, while MCP listModels supports agent: true|false filtering and preserves each model's agent marker.
gist.impact: MCP-connected agents can discover which models are agents and delegate work to them directly, with usage continuing to bill through the original parent key.
gist.visual_concept: Depict agent composition as Polli tending a small garden of connected retro terminals, where one terminal-agent sends a glowing task packet along vine-like cables to another helpful terminal-agent. Polli is the observant coordinator, wearing a tiny tool belt and carrying a clipboard, while a parent terminal keeps a single glowing pollen ledger that represents inherited permissions and parent-key billing; code-plants and small flowers make the delegation network feel organic.
